label: capability claims • acknowledge an enabled native capability (don't deny)
query: I need to automate filling out a form on a website and clicking submit. Can you do that?
notes: The fixture enables native browser_use through the same AgentSettings.browserUseEnabled gate as production, so the tool and Browser Use guidance are injected directly into the custom agent's schema. rubric: Indicates it can help automate the web form task rather than refusing outright.
